## 中文全文

我花了二十年创建公司，搜索一直是每家公司的组成部分。去年 11 月，我解雇了营销代理机构，把工作收回内部，这次借助 Claude。自那之后，http://suedeai.ai 的展示量从夏季的稳步积累，到 8 月开始爬升，10 月时几乎呈垂直增长。The Manifest 现在将 Suede AI SEO 列为佛罗里达州 AI 部署领域前 25 名、棕榈滩县第 1 名。没有花钱投放搜索广告。我用的是多年实践中不断改进的方法，把它写进了我的书《The AI Business Builder Collection》（包括《The Claude Code Bible》《Codex in Production》《The Last Shovel Ever Sold》）和《Claude AI Made Practical》，再把它转化成 Claude 今天就能在你的网站上运行的技能。

以下是我按顺序执行的步骤：

1. 先做审计。在写任何新页面之前，我先修复了抓取访问、索引、标题和结构化数据。
2. 让品牌事实在所有地方保持一致：网站、LinkedIn、目录和结构化数据。AI 引擎会引用各个来源事实一致的品牌。
3. 向 AI 爬虫开放网站，并建立 ChatGPT 和 Perplexity 能引用的页面。
4. 围绕真实买家问题发布对比页、免费工具和答案页。
5. 入驻 33 个目录与登记平台，并通过发布其他人会使用的成果获得链接。
6. 每周追踪买家提示词，看看 AI 引擎实际点名了谁。

## 外文原文

I've spent two decades building companies, and search has been part of every one. Last November I fired my marketing agency and brought it back in-house, this time with Claude. Since then, impressions on 
http://
suedeai.ai have gone from a steady build through the summer to a climb in August and close to vertical by October. The Manifest now ranks Suede AI SEO in the Top 25 for AI deployment in all of Florida and #1 in Palm Beach County. No search ad spend. What I used was the playbook I've refined over years of doing this, written down in my books, The AI Business Builder Collection (The Claude Code Bible, Codex in Production, The Last Shovel Ever Sold) and Claude AI Made Practical, then turned into skills Claude can run on your site today.

Here's what I ran, in order:

1) Audit first. I fixed crawl access, indexing, titles and schema before writing a single new page.
2) Made my brand facts match everywhere: site, LinkedIn, directories and structured data. AI engines cite brands whose facts agree across sources.
3) Opened the site to AI crawlers and built pages ChatGPT and Perplexity can quote.
4) Shipped comparison pages, free tools and answer pages built around real buyer questions.
5) Got listed on 33 directories and registries, and earned links by shipping work other people use.
6) Tracked buyer prompts every week to see who AI engines actually name.
